cases.name: fragments-within-one-rr
cases.note: character-strings of one RR are concatenated; unknown keys are ignored; multiple ds values are kept

cases.name: duplicate-token
cases.error: duplicate token key in one RR
cases.note: two token keys in one RR are ambiguous; the RR is ignored for matching

cases.name: token-47-octets
cases.error: token decodes to 47 octets; SHA-384 gives 48 and SHA-512 gives 64
cases.note: the RFC's own printed example would be rejected by this rule

cases.name: no-token
cases.note: a Verification Record without a token authorises nothing

description: Verification Record TXT parsing cases (RFC 9704 sections 5, 6 and 7).
